summary: Frontend-only mobile (390x800) testing of 9 rare-ritual overlays after new realistic 3D PNG assets were added (tiki-mug, tiki-volcano, reaper-coffin-closed, reaper-coffin-open, reaper-candle). Used ff_rare_force + ff_deal_taps=9 + ff_rare_at=10 + ff_theme + ff_theme_hint_seen=1 + ff_theme_chosen=1 + ff_muted=1 to deterministically force each variant. All 9 overlays render, all new PNG assets load correctly (no 404s), all rituals reach their 'done' state, and no console/pageerror events observed. Restaurant reveal after ritual dismissal was confirmed visually (e.g. crank -> 'Carney's Restaurant' shown under steam theme background). Standard spin flow regression is intact (guided-flow -> zip -> spin button -> ritual overlay -> reveal).

ui_bugs.issue: In one automated run, rapid programmatic clicks on seance-candle-0..4 (150-250ms apart) did not always mark every candle as snuffed - the prompt 'Snuff the candles, one by one...' remained visible instead of transitioning to 'The spirits have chosen...'. In a prior slower run all 5 candles snuffed correctly and 'seance-done' was reached. Likely a fast-tap race where setState (functional array update) is missed because snuff() reads stale out[] via closure (uses `out.map` on the closed-over `out`, not a functional updater). Consider changing setOut(next) to setOut((prev)=>...) to prevent skipped updates when a user (or test) taps very quickly.

Single programmatic click on button[data-testid='fairy-wand'] intermittently does not trigger cast() - overlay remained on 'Tap the wand' prompt with opacity:1 after 10s+. Real user taps work fine visually. May be a framer-motion transformOrigin/rotate hit-testing quirk on the SVG child. Consider adding pointer-events:auto explicit or wrapping the click target in a larger div.

Playwright's normal .click() reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' even though bounding_box shows y=190 within a 390x800 viewport. JS .click() works fine. Likely the element has an animated transform that confuses viewport detection. Not user-facing, but flags flaky test surface.

issues: Assets render at nice quality - tiki mug, volcano, coffin closed/open cross-fade, and 5 dripping-wax candles all look like realistic 3D renders and blend with theme backgrounds. Candle flames sit correctly at the wick. No visual regressions observed.

action_items: (LOW) SeanceCandles.jsx line 41-42: change setOut(next) to setOut((prev) => prev.map((v,j)=> j===i?true:v)) to prevent stale-closure skipped snuffs during rapid tapping.
(LOW) FairyWand.jsx: consider enlarging the click target or adding an explicit onPointerDown handler; automated single-click sometimes misses the SVG-rotated button.
(INFO) No changes required for image assets - all 5 new PNGs are wired up correctly and render as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 1579 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline. Consider splitting per-ritual logic (shouldRareFate, rare pool, surpriseDone) into a hook.
SeanceCandles.snuff() uses stale closure over `out` array; not resilient to rapid input. Use functional setState update.
Each ritual duplicates the same doneRef + setTimeout(onDone, ~2000ms) fade pattern - could be extracted into a shared useRareFateFade hook to DRY (~9 files).
ff_rare_force is trusted from localStorage without validation of the current theme's pool at spin time - fine for testing, but worth an inline comment that this is a dev/QA switch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% overlay-render + asset-load; ~90% end-to-end interactions (seance/wand flaky under automation only)

seed_data_creation: None. Restaurant fallback seed served the results (ZIP 90210 used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 rare-ritual variants and their new 3D PNG assets are working. Force a variant with localStorage BEFORE the deal tap: set ff_theme, ff_theme_hint_seen=1, ff_theme_chosen=1 (or you'll be blocked by ThemeWelcomeDialog), ff_muted=1, ff_deal_taps=9, ff_rare_at=10, ff_rare_force=<variant>. After reload, click data-testid='guided-skip' to dismiss GuidedFlow, fill data-testid='zip-input' with 90210 (Home.jsx does NOT read a ff_zip localStorage - zip must be in React state), then click data-testid='spin-roulette-button'. All 9 ritual data-testids exist and the code paths call onDone -> setSurpriseReveal(null) which unmounts the ritual correctly (verified by seeing the restaurant card appear post-ritual in crank test).
rca of the issue: n/a - no blocking bugs. Two low-priority items: (1) SeanceCandles uses stale-closure setState which can drop rapid taps; fix by switching to functional updater. (2) FairyWand SVG button is a small hit target rotated by framer-motion; automation single-clicks can miss. Both do not affect the assets or the reveal pipeline.
